title: malaxis andicola var. elata
intro:

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis andicola var. elata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from infections and inflammation.
